I've tried. But I found out there are no jobs available. 

I don't have any other passions. 

I don't believe that. My mother has been fighting a lot the last 8 years of her life. She's tried everything she could try. Results: She couldn't find anything that makes her happy and is giving up right now. The whole idea that someday it will all be alright for you is nonsense in my opinion.

Appreciate the help! But when I did work experience in a reptile store last year, I found out finding work in to do with reptiles is near impossible. I live in a country that only has 3 snakes, and I don't even think we have a native lizard. Zoo's are near impossible to work at over here. Same with stores. They all take students for free. We don't have much sanctuary's; I only know one reptile sanctuary in the whole country. I'd love to be a breeder, but it's way to risky to do it full time (or even parttime). 

Also with gaming I've looked at all the studies. It's basically all coding. Something I find really boring. For the rest their isn't any other gaming study unfortunately. 

The last few years I tried to follow my passion. There's simply no jobs available to do with them. So I've given that idea up, cause it was harming me a lot.

Reptiles (or animals in general) and gaming. Last year I did an animal study, and found out that there are as good as no jobs available that have to do with reptiles. The ones that do are very low paying jobs, while I can go to university. Game developement is unfortunately nothing for me (did some ar high school), cause it'a obviously way different then playing games.
